<!--
Platform cards for the RStudio Desktop (open source) installers.

Written as raw HTML rather than Quarto divs so the card titles stay out of the
page's table of contents. Keep each card's markup free of blank lines: a blank
line would split it into several raw blocks and let Pandoc reinterpret the
remainder as Markdown.

NOTE: the same URLs are built in
docs/user/rstudio/assets/_download.html for the recommended-download hero.
Update both together.
-->

<div class="download-cards">
<div id="card-macos" class="download-card">
<h4><i class="bi bi-apple" aria-hidden="true"></i> macOS <span class="option-meta">14+</span></h4>
<div class="download-group">
<div class="download-option">
<div class="option-label">Universal<br><span class="option-meta">(Apple Silicon &amp; Intel)</span></div>
<a class="download-link" href="https://download1.rstudio.org/electron/macos/RStudio-{{< var osVersion >}}.dmg" aria-label="Download RStudio-{{< var osVersion >}}.dmg for macOS"><i class="bi bi-download" aria-hidden="true"></i> .dmg</a>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div id="card-windows" class="download-card">
<h4><i class="bi bi-windows" aria-hidden="true"></i> Windows <span class="option-meta">11</span></h4>
<div class="download-group">
<div class="download-option">
<div class="option-label">Installer</div>
<a class="download-link" href="https://download1.rstudio.org/electron/windows/RStudio-{{< var osVersion >}}.exe" aria-label="Download RStudio-{{< var osVersion >}}.exe for Windows"><i class="bi bi-download" aria-hidden="true"></i> .exe</a>
</div>
<div class="download-option">
<div class="option-label">Zip archive<br><span class="option-meta">(no installer required)</span></div>
<a class="download-link" href="https://download1.rstudio.org/electron/windows/RStudio-{{< var osVersion >}}.zip" aria-label="Download RStudio-{{< var osVersion >}}.zip for Windows"><i class="bi bi-download" aria-hidden="true"></i> .zip</a>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div id="card-linux" class="download-card">
<h4><i class="bi bi-terminal" aria-hidden="true"></i> Linux <span class="option-meta">x86_64</span></h4>
<div class="download-group">
<div class="download-option">
<div class="option-label">.deb<br><span class="option-meta">(Ubuntu 22 / 24 / 26, Debian 13)</span></div>
<a class="download-link" href="https://download1.rstudio.org/electron/jammy/amd64/rstudio-{{< var osVersion >}}-amd64.deb" aria-label="Download rstudio-{{< var osVersion >}}-amd64.deb for Ubuntu or Debian"><i class="bi bi-download" aria-hidden="true"></i> .deb</a>
</div>
<div class="download-option">
<div class="option-label">.rpm<br><span class="option-meta">(RHEL 9 / 10, Fedora)</span></div>
<a class="download-link" href="https://download1.rstudio.org/electron/rhel9/x86_64/rstudio-{{< var osVersion >}}-x86_64.rpm" aria-label="Download rstudio-{{< var osVersion >}}-x86_64.rpm for Red Hat or Fedora"><i class="bi bi-download" aria-hidden="true"></i> .rpm</a>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<details>
<summary>Other Linux formats</summary>
<p>Tarballs install without a package manager, for distributions the packages above do not cover.</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://download1.rstudio.org/electron/jammy/amd64/rstudio-{{< var osVersion >}}-amd64-debian.tar.gz"><code>rstudio-{{< var osVersion >}}-amd64-debian.tar.gz</code></a> &mdash; Ubuntu / Debian</li>
<li><a href="https://download1.rstudio.org/electron/rhel9/x86_64/rstudio-{{< var osVersion >}}-x86_64-fedora.tar.gz"><code>rstudio-{{< var osVersion >}}-x86_64-fedora.tar.gz</code></a> &mdash; RHEL / Fedora</li>
</ul>
</details>
